what_to_detect: A fateseal: a resolution looks at the top cards of an opponent's library and reorders that library (card_looked_at and library_reordered whose subject is an opponent of the acting player).
near_miss: A fateseal resolution that leaves the opponent's library in its order (every looked-at card kept on top in place), writing no library_reordered.
record_fields: library_reordered and card_looked_at events and their player subject
Forge has no Fateseal API: both fateseal scripts run a Dig on a chosen opponent below a ChoosePlayer or ChangeZone root, so api Dig misses them and selects every own-library Dig instead
